saveDamageSkillCastId.help: Record the current damage cast ID in this Buff to identify repeated hits.

readBuffStackCount.name: Count Buffs
readBuffStackCount.help: Count matching Buff stacks or instances and store the result.

dispelBuffs.name: Dispel Buffs
dispelBuffs.help: Remove dispellable buffs up to the selected dispel level, optionally filtered by tags.

finishBuffsByTag.name: End Buffs by Tag
finishBuffsByTag.help: Remove matching tagged Buffs, optionally limiting the count.

finishBuffsById.name: End Buffs by ID
finishBuffsById.help: Remove selected Buffs, optionally limiting the count.

finishCurrentBuff.name: End Current Buff
finishCurrentBuff.help: End the Buff running this effect.

setCurrentBuffTimePaused.name: Pause Buff Timer
setCurrentBuffTimePaused.help: Pause the remaining-duration countdown, or resume it.

igniteBuffs.name: Activate Buff Response
igniteBuffs.help: Trigger matching activation responses in the target’s Buffs.

adjustSkillCooldown.name: Change Skill Cooldown
adjustSkillCooldown.help: Reduce, increase or set the selected skill’s remaining cooldown.

holdBuffsById.name: Hold Buffs
holdBuffsById.help: Prevent selected Buffs from ending while this action is active.

inheritBuffById.name: Carry Buff to Next Skill
inheritBuffById.help: Keep the same Buff for an allowed next skill, without resetting time or stacks.

restrictUltimateEnergyRecovery.name: Restrict Ultimate Energy Recovery
restrictUltimateEnergyRecovery.help: Allow only selected recovery types, with an option to clear energy on end.

setGlobalCooldown.name: Set Global Cooldown
setGlobalCooldown.help: Set a named character cooldown. Setting it again refreshes the timer.

createTimedMarker.name: Add Timed Marker
createTimedMarker.help: Add a timed marker to the target for condition nodes to check.

startTimeDilation.name: Change Time Scale
startTimeDilation.help: Change time scale globally or for selected objects. 1 is normal; 0 pauses time.

startUltimateTimeDilation.name: Ultimate Time Dilation
startUltimateTimeDilation.help: Slow global time while this action is active, excluding the caster.

changeOriginSkillToEventContextSkill.name: Use event skill as origin
changeOriginSkillToEventContextSkill.help: Replace the current Buff or ability origin with the cast information of the current skill event.

storeCollectedBuffValue.name: Read collected Buff value
storeCollectedBuffValue.help: Copy a value from the Buff currently being initialized into the action blackboard.

modifyCollectedBuffValue.name: Modify collected Buff value
modifyCollectedBuffValue.help: Modify the new Buff blackboard before its duration and attributes are evaluated.

terminateAddingBuff.name: Cancel Buff Application
terminateAddingBuff.help: Cancel the current cancellable application event; continue executing subsequent actions.

hideUi.name: Hide UI or Block Input
hideUi.help: Hide the game UI or only block player input while the action is active.

setIgnoreGlobalTimeScale.name: Ignore Global Time Scale
setIgnoreGlobalTimeScale.help: Exclude selected entities from global time dilation, or restore it.

storeCharacterTypeCode.name: Store character element code
storeCharacterTypeCode.help: Write the first queried character’s element code to the blackboard: Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature and Physical map to 0 through 4. A missing or non-character target fails without changing the value.

storeProfession.name: Store character profession code
storeProfession.help: Write the first queried character’s native profession enum code to the blackboard. A missing character or profession fails without changing the value.

storeSquadSlot.name: Store character squad slot
storeSquadSlot.help: Write the first queried character’s zero-based squad slot to the blackboard. A missing character or squad member fails without changing the value.

storeCharacterTypeId.name: Read character type
storeCharacterTypeId.help: Stores the target character type in a variable. Fails if the target has no character-table entry.

storeCurrentTimelineFrame.name: Get Skill Frame
storeCurrentTimelineFrame.help: Store the current skill frame in a variable.

storeEventSpGainAmount.name: Get Event SP Recovery
storeEventSpGainAmount.help: Read requested and actual SP recovery from the current recovery event.

storeEventHealValues.name: Get Event Healing
storeEventHealValues.help: Read calculated healing and actual health restored from the current event.

storeShieldValue.name: Get Shield Value
storeShieldValue.help: Read the target’s shield or the shield added by the current event.

modifyActionValue.name: Set Variable
modifyActionValue.help: Set, add to or multiply a variable in the current scope.

calculateActionValue.name: Calculate and Store
calculateActionValue.help: Calculate a result from two inputs and store it in a variable.

storeSourceAttributeValue.name: Get Attribute Value
storeSourceAttributeValue.help: Read the first queried target’s attribute, apply rounding, scaling and offset, then store the result.

storeEntityPropertyValue.name: Get Health or Stagger
storeEntityPropertyValue.help: Read health or stagger, scale it and store the result.

overrideRawAttributes.name: Override Raw Attributes
overrideRawAttributes.help: Override target raw attributes while preserving modifiers, and restore them when the action ends.

setHealthFloor.name: Set Health Floor
setHealthFloor.help: Limit how low the target’s health can fall while this action is active.

changeResource.name: Change Resource
changeResource.help: Add or spend resources such as SP or Ultimate Energy. Positive adds; negative spends.

recoverDashEnergy.name: Restore Dodge Stamina
recoverDashEnergy.help: Restore shared dodge stamina. Stamina does not prevent dodging in this tool.

recordPerfectDodge.name: Trigger Perfect Dodge
recordPerfectDodge.help: Record a successful perfect dodge and trigger its responses.

gainSquadUltimateEnergyFromSkillCost.name: Recover Team Energy from Cost
gainSquadUltimateEnergyFromSkillCost.help: Recover Ultimate Energy for the team based on this skill’s cost.

gainFinisherSp.name: Recover Finisher SP
gainFinisherSp.help: Recover SP using the finisher recovery factor.

jumpTimeline.name: Jump on Skill Timeline
jumpTimeline.help: Advance to the selected frame when the condition is true. No condition means immediate.

reachSkillOperableBoundary.name: Allow Next Skill
reachSkillOperableBoundary.help: Allow the selected next skills from this point onward.

markCurrentSkillCanDash.name: Allow Dodge Cancel
markCurrentSkillCanDash.help: Allow a dodge to interrupt the current skill from this point.

markCurrentSkillCanInterrupt.name: Allow Skill Interruption
markCurrentSkillCanInterrupt.help: Mark the current skill as interruptible.

checkCondition.name: Check Condition
checkCondition.help: Continue this sequence only when the check succeeds.

physicsCast.name: Ground Raycast
physicsCast.help: Cast downwards from above each queried object, store the ground hit in the target context, and run the hit or miss branch.

checkActionResult.name: Check Action Result
checkActionResult.help: Execute the connected action sequence when this input is read and return whether it allows continuation. Never evaluate early or cache the result.

ifElse.name: If Else
ifElse.help: Read the boolean condition, then execute the true or false branch. Connect Check Action Result to run actions when evaluating the condition.

anyCondition.name: Any Condition
anyCondition.help: Read boolean conditions in order until one is true. Fail if none is true. Connect Check Action Result to run actions when evaluating a condition.

invertNextResult.name: Invert Next Result
invertNextResult.help: Invert the next action's success or failure without skipping the action.

conditional.name: Branch
conditional.help: Follow True when the condition passes, otherwise False. Wire each branch to its actions.

switch.name: Switch on Value
switch.help: Compare the input against cases in order and run the matching branch.

repeatEachTick.name: Repeat over Time
repeatEachTick.help: Repeat the body at the configured interval while the action is active.

launchProjectile.name: Launch projectile
launchProjectile.help: Launch a logical projectile and execute callbacks on its schedule without simulating motion.

openComboWindow.name: Open Combo Window
openComboWindow.help: Allow the selected operator to use the next combo skill during its window.

showComboRingQte.name: Set Combo Timing
showComboRingQte.help: Set the prompt and valid input periods for a timed combo.

changeSkillSlot.name: Change Skill Form
changeSkillSlot.help: Replace the skill used by future casts of a group, without changing a cast already running.

overrideBasicAttackMapping.name: Override Basic Attack
overrideBasicAttackMapping.help: Use the selected skill for basic attack input while this action is active.

overrideMultiDashLimit.name: Set Consecutive Dodge Limit
overrideMultiDashLimit.help: Set consecutive dodge count. A negative value means unlimited.

changePlayerActionMode.name: Change Action Mode
changePlayerActionMode.help: Change the mode used to select skills for subsequent inputs.

changeNativeSkillType.name: Change Skill Type
changeNativeSkillType.help: Change a skill’s category, such as basic attack or combo, without replacing it.

setCharacterPassiveUiValue.name: Update Passive Display
setCharacterPassiveUiValue.help: Update the value shown by the operator’s special icon, without changing combat effects.

inheritSkillCastInfoForBasicAttack.name: Inherit Source for Basic Attacks
inheritSkillCastInfoForBasicAttack.help: While this Buff is active, subsequent basic attacks use its source skill identity.

listenForCombatEvents.name: Listen for Combat Events
listenForCombatEvents.help: Run matching responses when events occur while this action is active.

callMacro.name: Call Macro
callMacro.help: Run a macro in this resource. Supply its inputs and continue from its outputs.

callResource.name: Call Resource
callResource.help: Run an entry in another skill, Buff or entity resource.

once.name: Do Once
once.help: During one cast, only the first call with this shared identifier runs the body.

conditionNode.name: Condition Reference
conditionNode.help: Use another condition node in this graph.

valueNode.name: Value Reference
valueNode.help: Use another value node in this graph.

blackboard.name: Get Variable
blackboard.help: Read a variable in the current scope. Connect it to a value input.

parameter.name: Get Macro Input
parameter.help: Read an input supplied by the macro caller. Macro inputs cannot be assigned.

skillHasHit.name: Skill has hit?
skillHasHit.help: Checks whether this cast has entered combat damage processing.

singleEnemyPresent.name: Single Enemy?
singleEnemyPresent.help: Check whether a single enemy is present.

checkMainCharacter.name: Check Main Character
checkMainCharacter.help: Check whether the specified target is the currently controlled operator.

characterTypeIn.name: Element Type Matches?
characterTypeIn.help: Check the target’s element type against the list.

globalBuffCountCompare.name: Compare Global Buff Count
globalBuffCountCompare.help: Compare active parent instances in the battle directory, across all sources.

operatorWeaponTypeIn.name: Weapon Type Matches?
operatorWeaponTypeIn.help: Check the first queried character’s weapon type. Missing or non-character targets do not match.

operatorRoleIn.name: Role Matches?
operatorRoleIn.help: Check the operator’s role against the list.

enemyRankIn.name: Enemy Rank Matches?
enemyRankIn.help: Check the enemy’s rank against the list.

enemySuperArmorCompare.name: Compare Enemy Super Armor
enemySuperArmorCompare.help: Compare the enemy’s super armor with the input.

targetStaggered.name: Target Staggered?
targetStaggered.help: Check whether the target is currently staggered.

healthCompare.name: Compare Health
healthCompare.help: Compare current health or health ratio.

poiseCompare.name: Compare Stagger
poiseCompare.help: Compare the target’s current stagger value.

stringEquals.name: Compare strings
stringEquals.help: Checks whether two strings are equal, including letter case.

actionValueCompare.name: Compare Values
actionValueCompare.help: Compare two inputs and return True or False.

buffBlackboardValueCompare.name: Read and Compare Buff Variable
buffBlackboardValueCompare.help: Store a Buff variable, then compare it. Returns False if no Buff is found.

probability.name: Probability Check
probability.help: Pass with the supplied probability. 0 never passes; 1 always passes.

eventProjectilePerfectDodgeCooldownEqual.name: Projectile Dodge Cooldown?
eventProjectilePerfectDodgeCooldownEqual.help: Check perfect dodge cooldown on the event projectile.

eventProjectileIgnoreImmuneLevelCompare.name: Compare Projectile Immunity Bypass
eventProjectileIgnoreImmuneLevelCompare.help: Compare the event projectile’s immunity bypass level.

entityCountCompare.name: Check Entity Count
entityCountCompare.help: Count entities selected by the query. Optionally exclude dead entities and store the count when the comparison succeeds.

targetObjectTypeMatch.name: Target Object Type Matches?
targetObjectTypeMatch.help: Pass when any queried target matches the specified object type.

targetsEqual.name: Target Sets Match?
targetsEqual.help: Check that both target sets contain each other, ignoring order and duplicates. Two empty sets match.

abilityEntityRemainingDurationCompare.name: Compare Entity Time Remaining
abilityEntityRemainingDurationCompare.help: Compare remaining seconds on the current entity and optionally store the value.

currentBuffStackCompare.name: Compare Current Buff Stacks
currentBuffStackCompare.help: Compare stacks on the Buff running this effect.

buffStackCompare.name: Compare Tagged Buff Stacks
buffStackCompare.help: Sum matching Buff stacks on the target and compare.

buffTagIdCountCompare.name: Compare Buff Type Count
buffTagIdCountCompare.help: Count distinct matching Buff types, not stacks or duplicate instances.

entityTagMatch.name: Entity Tags Match?
entityTagMatch.help: Check the target’s own tags, rather than its Buff tags.

buffIdStackCompare.name: Compare Named Buff Stacks
buffIdStackCompare.help: Sum stacks of the listed Buffs and compare.

globalCooldownPresent.name: Global Cooldown Active?
globalCooldownPresent.help: Check whether the named global cooldown is still active.

comboSkillPending.name: Combo Pending?
comboSkillPending.help: Check for a pending combo. Other cast requirements may still fail.

timedMarkerPresent.name: Timed Marker Present?
timedMarkerPresent.help: Check for an active named marker on the target.

eventDamageTagsMatch.name: Event Damage Categories Match?
eventDamageTagsMatch.help: Check damage categories such as basic attack or battle skill in a damage event.

eventDamageGameplayTagsMatch.name: Event Damage Tags Match?
eventDamageGameplayTagsMatch.help: Check effect tags carried by the event damage.

eventTransferredPartTagsMatch.name: Transferred Part Tags Match?
eventTransferredPartTagsMatch.help: Check the part mapped to the current main body in the event. Save the part target only on success; otherwise preserve the existing target group.

eventDamageFeaturesMatch.name: Event Damage Features Match?
eventDamageFeaturesMatch.help: Check features of the event damage.

eventDamageTypeIn.name: Event Damage Type Matches?
eventDamageTypeIn.help: Check the event damage’s physical or Arts type.

eventInflictionElementIn.name: Event Infliction Element Matches?
eventInflictionElementIn.help: Check the element applied by the event.

eventPhysicalInflictionTypeIn.name: Event Physical Status Matches?
eventPhysicalInflictionTypeIn.help: Check the type of physical status being applied.

eventSkillTypeIn.name: Event Skill Type Matches?
eventSkillTypeIn.help: Check the type of the skill being cast in this event.

eventCustomAbilityNameMatch.name: Custom Event Name Matches?
eventCustomAbilityNameMatch.help: Check a custom event’s name and optionally store its value.

currentSkillTypeIn.name: Current Skill Type Matches?
currentSkillTypeIn.help: Check the type of the skill the target is currently casting.

skillInterruptReasonIn.name: Interrupt reason matches?
skillInterruptReasonIn.help: Checks whether this skill interruption has one of the selected reasons.

originSkillTypeIn.name: Source Skill Type Matches?
originSkillTypeIn.help: Check the type of the skill that caused this event.

targetContains.name: Contains All Targets?
targetContains.help: Check whether the parent group contains every child target. An empty child group passes.

eventSkillIdIn.name: Event Skill in List?
eventSkillIdIn.help: Check whether the event skill is in the list.

eventSkillCastMatchesBuffSource.name: Cast Matches Buff Source?
eventSkillCastMatchesBuffSource.help: Check whether the event and Buff source belong to the same cast.

eventDamageSkillCastRecorded.name: Damage Cast Already Recorded?
eventDamageSkillCastRecorded.help: Check whether this Buff instance has recorded the current damage cast ID.

eventBuffIdMatch.name: Event Buff in List?
eventBuffIdMatch.help: Check whether the newly applied event Buff is in the list.

eventBuffEndedEarly.name: Buff Ended Early?
eventBuffEndedEarly.help: Check whether the event Buff ended before its timer expired.

eventBuffTagsMatch.name: Event Buff Tags Match?
eventBuffTagsMatch.help: Check tags on the newly applied event Buff.

eventHealTagsMatch.name: Event Healing Tags Match?
eventHealTagsMatch.help: Check tags carried by the healing event.

eventSpGainMatch.name: Event SP Recovery Matches?
eventSpGainMatch.help: Check the source and kind of SP recovery.

eventConsumedBuffLayerCompare.name: Compare Consumed Buff Stacks
eventConsumedBuffLayerCompare.help: Compare actual Buff stacks consumed by this event and optionally store them.

eventOverheal.name: Overhealing?
eventOverheal.help: Check whether healing exceeds missing health. Optionally store requested, actual and excess healing.

ownerSpawnedAbilityEntityPresent.name: Spawned Entity Present?
ownerSpawnedAbilityEntityPresent.help: Check whether the caster has an active matching entity.

all.name: AND
all.help: Check conditions in order. Stop at the first False; return True only if all pass.

any.name: OR
any.help: Check conditions in order. Stop and return True at the first passing condition.

deckAttributeCompare.name: Compare Build Attributes
deckAttributeCompare.help: Compare two operator attributes from the build.

stringOperand.name: String value
stringOperand.help: A literal or string read from the current action blackboard. Each consumer reads its own current context.

triggerCharacterInflictionEvent.name: Notify operator infliction
triggerCharacterInflictionEvent.help: Notify effects listening for an operator receiving an infliction or an elemental status.

applyCharacterInfliction.name: Inflict operator
applyCharacterInfliction.help: Apply elemental infliction to the selected operators, or trigger its status directly.

setBuffRemainingDuration.name: Change remaining status duration
setBuffRemainingDuration.help: Find statuses by ID or tag, then set, add to, or scale their remaining duration.

skillDamageTypeIn.name: Check skill element
skillDamageTypeIn.help: Check the event skill’s element, or the executing skill when there is no event skill.

aura.name: Aura
aura.help: Maintain aura Buff instances per target and execute entry and exit callbacks.

targetDistance.name: Target distance check
targetDistance.help: Compare the first targets of two queries. Missing targets fail the check.

copyContextTargets.name: Copy target group
copyContextTargets.help: Copies targets in order, preserving duplicates. An empty source clears the destination.

findTargets.name: Find targets
findTargets.help: Find targets and replace the output group. A missing owner leaves the group unchanged; an empty result clears it.

finishOwner.name: Finish target entities
finishOwner.help: End the selected summoned entities or projectiles. Ending flight does not trigger a timeout skill.

playAnimation.name: Animation
playAnimation.help: Run the end callback when the animation finishes, optionally excluding interruptions.

interruptCurrentSkill.name: Interrupt current skill
interruptCurrentSkill.help: End the skill currently being executed by the selected targets.

queueComboLock.name: Lock combo queue
queueComboLock.help: Append a timed lock. Existing windows stay available; later windows must wait for the lock to expire.

disableNormalSkill.name: Disable battle skill
disableNormalSkill.help: Apply a battle-skill restriction while the action is active, optionally allowing additional stages.

limitMovementGait.name: Limit movement gait
limitMovementGait.help: Write the owner's shared gait limit. A maximum below Sprint marks dodge inputs as forced. The limit clears after all gait actions end.
